queries.text: Proven only by text that either (a) contains no description of any solely-automated decision-making producing legal or similarly significant effects (in which case this proposition is NOT RAISED by the text — treat as not applicable, neither proved nor contradicted), OR (b) where such automated decision-making IS described, names which Article 22(2) exception applies AND commits to human intervention, a right to express a view, and a right to contest the decision. A contract describing an automated scoring, screening, or eligibility tool with no mention of human-intervention or contest rights is a GAP — do not treat a generic 'we comply with applicable data protection law' statement as satisfying this; Article 22 requires specific, operative safeguards.
